title: Guideline Authoring Artifacts Explorer
description: See one diabetes-screening rule as narrative, decision table, flowchart, and user story, with color-linked highlighting across all four.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: clinical guidelines
requirements engineering
decision tables
user stories
knowledge representation

educational.audience: Undergraduate students and healthcare data practitioners
learningObjectives: Given the same diabetes-screening guideline expressed as a narrative sentence, a decision table row, a flowchart branch, and a user story, the learner can differentiate what each artifact type captures that the others do not, and classify a new artifact example by type.
